thesis: Officer mobility cannot be responsibly tracked until agencies, subunits, government parties, prosecutors, and denominator scopes are separated.
new_rule: An agency identity candidate is not a canonical department record.
public_page_opening_policy: source inventory stub only until external identifiers and denominator/jurisdiction gates pass
hard_blocks: territorial agency normalization through city/county templates
public current-status banners from source labels
BJS reference-date denominators displayed as current facts
downstream_use: This spine will support department pages, settlement denominators, officer employment timelines, and wandering-officer detection only after gates pass.
